summary: Implemented every stub in jwt/api_jws.py (PyJWS encode, decode, decode_complete, _load, signature verification, header validation, algorithm registry), jwt/api_jwt.py (PyJWT encode, decode, decode_complete, payload hooks, all claim validators) and jwt/help.py (info and main), and added the missing _get_default_options helpers. The last full-suite run did not collect: 9 test modules failed to import because jwt/utils.py still lacks base64url_decode, base64url_encode, force_bytes and related helpers that another builder owns, so no tests ran and the counts are unknown.
